answer: Treat each identity as a ship that must dock at a public wharf. The protocol sends unpredictable probes through independent vantage points and records the routes they take; keys arriving along the same transit ledge, one rack, one provider, one latency signature, merge into a single cluster and are paid as one. Honest agents keep a stable berth; a sybil farm needs a separate voyage for every identity, buying distinct providers, addresses and route shapes, then keeping each alive under probing. Cloning stops scaling because each extra identity carries its recurring network bill and exposure.
